# Yufemi Wellness

> Yufemi Wellness is a small-batch sea moss brand that makes ready-to-use sea moss gel for busy people. Its first product is Elderberry Ginger Sea Moss Gel: sea moss, elderberry, ginger and spring water, 16 oz jar, $30, kept refrigerated. Yufemi's rallying line is "DO YUFEMI", about a culture of growth, self-improvement and action. Yufemi Wellness is a brand of Yufemi Consulting Group LLC, North Carolina, USA.

Key facts:
- Product: Elderberry Ginger Sea Moss Gel ("Immune Support Blend"), 16 oz, $30 USD
- Ingredients: sea moss, elderberry, ginger, spring water (four ingredients)
- Use: about a tablespoon a day, stirred into smoothies, tea, juice, oatmeal or yogurt, or eaten from the spoon
- Storage: refrigerate; stays fresh about 3–4 weeks; can be frozen in ice cube trays for up to 6 months
- Coming soon: blends for beauty, energy, gut and mood; skincare; apparel
- Contact: hello@yufemi.com
- Safety: sea moss is high in iodine; people with thyroid conditions, who are pregnant or nursing, or who take prescription medication should consult a healthcare provider first. These statements have not been evaluated by the FDA; the product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.
